79|sevenine.in Legal Documentation

Trademark Non-Affiliation Statement

SEVENINE (sevenine.in) is an independent peer-to-peer student exchange and academic networking platform established in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Zero Official Affiliation: SEVENINE is not affiliated with, endorsed by, approved by, authorized by, sponsored by, or in any way officially connected with:

  • The International Baccalaureate Organization (IBO, Geneva/Cardiff/Singapore)
  • Cambridge University Press & Assessment / Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE, UK)
  • Any specific school or testing administration authority unless explicitly certified under a mutual written agreement.

"International Baccalaureate", "IB", "IB Diploma Programme", "MYP", and related emblems are registered trademarks owned exclusively by the International Baccalaureate Organization. "Cambridge", "IGCSE", "O-Level", and "A-Level" are registered trademarks owned by Cambridge Assessment International Education. All references to curricula, syllabus codes, and grading bands (such as the 7-point scale or 9-point scale) are strictly nominative references for educational descriptive accuracy.

Academic Integrity & Anti-Plagiarism Policy

SEVENINE is built to foster intellectual curiosity, discussion, and legitimate peer support. We strictly prohibit any activities that compromise academic honesty.

Prohibited Actions on SEVENINE:

  • Plagiarism & Ghostwriting: Soliciting, producing, purchasing, or selling coursework, completed Internal Assessments (IA), Extended Essays (EE), Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essays, or IGCSE portfolios.
  • Confidential Examination Content: Uploading or soliciting live exam papers, leaked mark schemes, or confidential test materials prior to official public release.
  • Impersonation: Presenting another student's original experimental data or intellectual findings as one's own.

Violators are subject to immediate account termination, content removal, and reporting to relevant institution coordinators where legally required.

Student Privacy Safeguards

Protecting high school students and underage participants is fundamental to SEVENINE:

  • Voluntary Disclosures: Students retain total control over what is visible on their public profile (e.g., subject choices, predicted milestones, or sports interests).
  • No Data Brokering: SEVENINE does not sell, rent, or trade student profiles, phone numbers, or academic data to third-party commercial tutoring mills or advertising aggregators.
  • Moderation: All open exchange channels are monitored by senior peer moderators and verified student leads to prevent harassment, trolling, or spam.

Terms of Use & Limitation of Liability

1. Service Provided "As-Is": SEVENINE is provided on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis for informational, community, and networking convenience.

2. Academic Disclaimer: Advice, feedback, predictions, or study materials shared by community members represent individual student opinions only. SEVENINE makes no warranty regarding academic grades, diploma awards, examination outcomes, or university admissions decisions.

3. User Conduct: By accessing sevenine.in, users agree to treat all peers with dignity, maintain respectful discourse, and comply with all applicable local and national laws.
